page_title: MAL 2-1 VAL | Mallorca v Valencia 29/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+3' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after German Valera (Valencia) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
90+2' Andre Almeida (Valencia) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Dominik Greif comes off his line to intercept.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Neat passing move from Valencia in order to create new attacking opportunities.
86' Valencia take a short corner kick.
85' The game has come to an end for Sergi Darder. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
84' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Andre Almeida (Valencia) replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
84' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Yarek Gasiorowski walks off the pitch to be replaced by Dani Gomez (Valencia).
81' 2 - 1 Abdon Prats (Mallorca) heads the ball home after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
81' Jose Gaya (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but Dominik Greif punches the ball away.
80' Wonderful movement by Valencia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Cyle Larin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
78' Substitution. Mateu Morey Bauza makes his way off the pitch and Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) comes on as his replacement.
77' Shots on target – 3:1.
75' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. German Valera (Valencia) replaces Luis Rioja.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Pepelu (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Javi Guerra can be given a rest.
73' The Valencia players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martin Valjent (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Daniel Rodriguez will be replaced by Valery (Mallorca).
70' The attendance is 17717.
70' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Robert Navarro (Mallorca) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Antonio Sanchez.
69' The game is interrupted now, Robert Navarro (Mallorca) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
66' Great teamplay by Valencia as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
62' Luis Rioja (Valencia) picked up a yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
59' Luis Rioja (Valencia) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

58' Jose Gaya (Valencia) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. Valencia force their opponents to concede a corner.
56' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post.

55' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Mallorca are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
51' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.

49' Mallorca slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' 1 - 1 Referee Alejandro Quintero points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) goes wild in celebration.
45+4' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Alejandro Quintero wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
45+3' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Cyle Larin (Mallorca) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag. Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) is adjudged offside.
45+1' Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Alejandro Quintero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
40' A cross from a corner kick by Valencia is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
39' Valencia fail to score from a corner as Dominik Greif (Mallorca) leaps to collect the ball.
38' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
37' A pass into the penalty area from Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
37' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) takes the corner but it's cleared.

36' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Giorgi Mamardashvili stops the ball from going inside right post. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Mallorca.
34' Valencia are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! Luis Rioja (Valencia) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Dominik Greif.
32' Luis Rioja (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
31' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Valencia!

30' Play continues despite the shouts by some Valencia players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Alejandro Quintero interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
30' Surely that's handball by one of the Mallorca players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
29' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
28' Wonderful movement by Valencia. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
26' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
24' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

24' Diego Lopez (Valencia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' A flowing move ends with a great cross into the centre of the box, which Diego Lopez (Valencia) latches onto but sends a wild header well wide of the right post.
21' Some neat passing and movement from Valencia as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
19' A cross from the by-line finds Cyle Larin (Mallorca) unmarked on the penalty spot, but he is unable to find the target and sends his header well wide of the left post.
16' Valencia are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
14' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) wins the battle with the defender and plants a header goalwards from the corner, but his effort from around the penalty spot sails harmlessly past the right post.
14' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) will take the corner.
14' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Mallorca get a corner.
13' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

12' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.
11' Mallorca showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
7' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
5' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mallorca.
3' Robert Navarro (Mallorca) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
1' Valencia enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Mallorca will kick the game off.
